name: Quiet clock
summary: A 24-hour clock with each roommate's sleep as a ring in their color; where everyone is asleep at once the clock darkens into quiet hours. Drag the ends of your ring to fix your sleep, everyone taps Agree, and the quiet hours get pinned as the house rule.
useWhen: roommates with clashing schedules: 6am alarms vs 1am guitar
can we set quiet hours for the apartment
someone's too loud at night, need a house rule for when to keep it down
figure out when everyone in the house is asleep
new roommate, agree on noise hours
dontUseWhen: finding a time to meet up (use meeting-time)

sub.description: Under the title: the standoff in the chat's words

sleep.description: Up to 6 people's usual sleep, 24-hour times like '23:30' and '6:00' (15-minute steps), with a short note in their words

agreed.description: Names of who already agreed to the quiet hours as they stand
